cohorts.definition: observations where no contacted receptor residue differs from the reference
observations whose contacted residues all matched the reference identity
observations with at least one contacted residue whose reference identity was unavailable
observations on structures with a chimeric fusion or reported mutations

rules: a mutated motif residue keeps its geometry record and is flagged mutation_sensitive
a structure carrying mutations is never excluded wholesale
warnings are raised at residue / contact / motif level only
an unresolved mutation is never treated as wild type
